name: Enterprise Workforce Landscape and Scope
constraints: Workforce Landscape is a reproducible projection and Workforce Scope is its versioned population and counting profile.
Neither construct creates a subject-model identity or writes to person, employment, assignment, position or organization masters.
Every published figure pins perimeter, world time, knowledge time, period convention, scope revision and source revisions.
Unique persons, legal headcount, distinct employed persons, active relationships, assignments, positions, FTE and capacity remain separately named measures.
Each measure declares its denominator, counting basis, consolidation and deduplication rules.
Person identity is resolved by WM-PER-001 anchor and never inferred from relationship multiplicity.
Employment, assignment and position identities remain distinct and active status is asserted rather than inferred.
Vacant positions contribute position or demand-side FTE measures but never create people.
Contractors, volunteers and agency workers may contribute assignments, allocated FTE or capacity without host legal headcount.
Dual employment creates multiple employment relationships but one person; cross-employer allocated FTE may exceed 1.0 under a declared method.
Unknown, suppressed and zero remain distinct states.
Scenario results remain separate from authoritative results.
WM-XCT-002 constrains purpose and audience while WM-XCT-003 fixes aggregate shape, suppression, grain and linkability.
Person anchors are resolved inside population calculation and never emitted in the released view.
Released views carry a reproducible fingerprint, provenance tuple, completeness state and suppression markers.
holds: WM-ORG-005 and WM-ORG-016 remain non-canonical and their composition relation is unapproved.
No shared normative FTE or headcount definition and no verified crosswalk exist.
Workforce measurement remains a gap in WM-ORG-016 and extension-grade in WM-ORG-002.
Privacy and cohort controls require independent validation.
Independent Grok review and one frozen audit remain pending.
